HEEWON STYLE. Minimal iconic 2:1 still, composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. Two-shot in the western flower field: LEFT of sheet = mortal Kangrim (gaunt fever on two feet, hands half-reaching for the hoe then stopping); CENTER = the young gardener Hallakgungi face and plain field clothes from ch_gardener; RIGHT = place board pl_western_flower_field for the endless flower rows — match that field. Gardener cutting three flowers; Kangrim drained and loud with distance-madness held barely in. ONE device: three cut stems as a bright vertical. Day high-key flower haze, paper-white sky. Kangrim hex #4a4a58 as cool shadow; gardener #8FBF8A as leaf-light bounce — real light, not glow auras. No text. No watermark.
